# ProveCalc

> ProveCalc is a Mathcad-style engineering calculation worksheet in which every assumption, unit and result is checked, not just calculated. The desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) runs the calculation on your own machine and works offline after activation; AI help is optional and never performs the calculation. A free browser demo is available. Built by The Mnemosyne Research Institute in Safford, Arizona.

## Product

- [Home](https://provecalc.com/): what ProveCalc is and how its checks work
- [Free web demo](https://provecalc.com/app): hosted browser worksheet, no sign-up
- [Pricing](https://provecalc.com/pricing): one-time $200 lifetime desktop license, 3 machine activations, free updates, 30-day refund, no subscription
- [Download](https://provecalc.com/download): desktop installers and release notes

## Facts worth quoting

- Worksheets are open JSON files that stay on your machine and export to PDF, DOCX and HTML.
- Each node is checked for unit consistency, constraint satisfaction, numeric residuals and sanity.
- Licenses verify offline: there is no activation server to keep reachable.
- ProveCalc contact: admin@provecalc.com
- Support: contact@themnemosyneresearchinstitute.com
